ANSWER: Three non-test CLI files in `internal/cli` call `lock.ReadLockfile` (defined at `pkg/lock/lock.go:45`), so a format change would affect all three:

1. `internal/cli/pull.go`, in `cmdPull`, at line 160. It reads `okf.lock` after installing a bundle. If the read fails, which includes a parse failure on a new format, it silently falls back to `&lock.Lockfile{Version: 1}`. It then calls `lf.Upsert(...)` and writes the lockfile back. A format mismatch could therefore quietly discard the existing lock entries.
2. `internal/cli/vendor.go`, in `cmdVendor`, at lines 37 and 62. These are two separate read sites, one per vendor code path.
3. `internal/cli/restore.go`, in `runRestore`, at line 64. `cmdRestore` calls `runRestore`, so it is affected indirectly.

Tests that call it directly would also break: `internal/cli/restore_test.go:106` and `pkg/lock/lock_test.go:29`.

CONFIDENCE: high
